title: Personal Credit Cards: Payment Crediting, Minimum Payment and Payment Allocation
content:
This page covers the day on which a payment to Personal Credit Cards counts as received, the size of each statement's minimum payment, and the order in which a payment is spread across balances.

## Crediting date

- Payments arriving on a business day no later than 17:00 Eastern Time are credited that same day.
- A payment arriving after 17:00, or on a weekend or a Federal Reserve holiday, is credited on the following business day.
- If a due date lands on a day on which the bank neither accepts mail nor processes payments, crediting on the business day that follows still counts as on time.

## Minimum payment due

The minimum payment on a statement is the larger of two figures: the tier's smallest minimum payment, and the tier's percentage of the new statement balance increased by the interest and fees that the statement itself bills. The result is rounded half-up to the cent and is capped at the statement balance. A statement whose balance is 0.00 USD or less carries no minimum payment.

## Allocation of a payment

The part of a payment up to the minimum payment is applied to the balance type carrying the lowest APR before any other. Anything beyond the minimum is directed to the balance type bearing the highest APR, then the next highest, and so on, in line with the CARD Act. A payment larger than the whole balance leaves a credit balance, which is refunded when the cardholder asks.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A statement shows a new balance of 2600.00 USD, of which 31.50 USD is interest and 0.00 USD fees, on a tier with a hypothetical percentage of 2 percent and a hypothetical smallest minimum of 30.00 USD. Two percent of 2600.00 USD is 52.00 USD; adding the interest gives 83.50 USD, which exceeds 30.00 USD, so the minimum is 83.50 USD. On a statement balance of 18.40 USD the smallest minimum would exceed the balance, so the minimum would be 18.40 USD.

## Basis Q&A

- **A payment arrives at 17:20 on a Friday. When is it credited?** On the next business day, normally the following Monday unless that is a Federal Reserve holiday.
- **A payment of 500.00 USD meets a minimum of 83.50 USD. Where does the rest go?** The 83.50 USD goes to the lowest-APR balance type; the remaining 416.50 USD goes to the highest-APR balance type and onward in falling APR order.
